name: Lisette Albert
original_name: リゼット゠アルベール
source:
A second-year student at Amatsuchi Academy. Her family is among the wealthiest in the world. She calls herself the "Shining Alber."

Last year, she enrolled at Amatsuchi Academy together with Patricia and, at the same time, joined the Ruins Exploration Club. Using the power of money, she recruited capable adventurers one after another, and in the span of just one year, grew her own guild, the "Lisette Paladin Order," into one of the academy's foremost organizations.

She openly declares that she will "completely conquer Amatsuchi," and diligently faces her daily adventures.

Her personality is the complete opposite of rough or uncouth, possessing a refinement one would not expect from an adventurer. She almost never behaves arrogantly (meaning: she does, once in a while). Rather, she is charming in a puppy-like way. As for herself, she is of absolutely no use in adventures.

The protagonist, who possesses an unusual background and is highly skilled with the sword, naturally ends up attracting her interest.
